import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static int n, m;
    static long[] a;
    static List<Long> a1List = new ArrayList<>();
    static List<Long> a2List = new ArrayList<>();
    static int n1;

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        if (!sc.hasNextInt()) return;
        n = sc.nextInt();
        m = sc.nextInt();
        a = new long[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            a[i] = sc.nextLong();
        }
        n1 = n / 2;

        sums1(0, 0);
        sums2(n1, 0);

        // Sort and remove duplicates from a1
        Collections.sort(a1List);
        List<Long> uniqueA1 = new ArrayList<>();
        if (!a1List.isEmpty()) {
            uniqueA1.add(a1List.get(0));
            for (int i = 1; i < a1List.size(); i++) {
                if (!a1List.get(i).equals(a1List.get(i - 1))) {
                    uniqueA1.add(a1List.get(i));
                }
            }
        }

        long ans = 0;
        for (long i : a2List) {
            long target = m - i;
            int idx = Collections.binarySearch(uniqueA1, target);
            int pos;
            if (idx < 0) {
                pos = -(idx + 1);
            } else {
                pos = idx;
            }
            
            // Python's bisect_left returns the leftmost insertion point.
            // a1[j-1] where j is bisect_left(a1, m-i)
            if (pos > 0) {
                long val = uniqueA1.get(pos - 1) + i;
                if (ans < val) {
                    ans = val;
                }
            } else {
                // If pos == 0, j-1 is -1. In Python, a1[-1] is the last element.
                if (!uniqueA1.isEmpty()) {
                    long val = uniqueA1.get(uniqueA1.size() - 1) + i;
                    if (ans < val) {
                        ans = val;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        System.out.println(ans);
    }

    static void sums1(int i, long sum) {
        if (i == n1) {
            a1List.add(sum);
        } else {
            sums1(i + 1, (sum + a[i]) % m);
            sums1(i + 1, sum);
        }
    }

    static void sums2(int i, long sum) {
        if (i == n) {
            a2List.add(sum);
        } else {
            sums2(i + 1, (sum + a[i]) % m);
            sums2(i + 1, sum);
        }
    }
}
